verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe Financial Connections exposes raw transaction history and balances, the latter positioned for underwriting, plus an agent-oriented 'spending analysis' use case. It documents no derived income or cash-flow signals: no recurring-stream detection, no payroll detection and no income verification product. Raw transaction data is a developer building block, and spending analysis is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform derives income and cash-flow signals from connected accounts — recurring streams, payroll detection, or documented income verification products built on the same data

citations.quote: reduce underwriting risk with balances data
